# cipher tokens {total}: {HCSMIU}. H = key value equals the period-gloss chunk the alignment puts over this very token
# (the period interlinear decipherment of that group; align/align_all.tsv via votes.tsv), on a code whose value holds in >=2
# aligned occurrences; C = keyed token with no aligned chunk of its own, value from the code's other occurrences; M = own
# chunk disagrees, single-attestation or unsettled code, or an uncertain digit; I = cipher numeral repeating the gloss's numeral;
# U = code not in key.tsv. Both letters cleared per-letter controls first (align/per_letter.txt). Clear text is printed as

# transcribed. The run-level plaintext of the cipher passages is the period interlinear decipherment (align/pairs.tsv plain_raw). S = value chosen by the READ2-PAG homophone pass (align/PREREG_homophone.md, align/homophone_pass.txt), token chunk agreeing or absent. Also S: value held in each letter alone by the RUN1-PAG Gibbs segmentation pass (align/PREREG_seg2.md, align/gibbs_pass.txt), same chunk-agreeing-or-absent rule.
